question_text: The Department of Education (DepEd) plans to implement a new curriculum that emphasizes science and technology but reduces the number of hours for arts and music. A parent group challenges this, citing the constitutional right to quality education. Under Article XIV of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following is the most relevant provision?

options.text: The State shall establish and maintain a system of free public education at the elementary and high school levels.
The State shall assign the highest budgetary priority to education.
The State shall protect and promote the right of all citizens to quality education at all levels.
The State shall ensure that the curriculum is exclusively focused on science and technology.
